how.title: How Saqina helps
how.intro: Six steps from a rough idea to something your team uses every day.

steps.title: Understand the need
steps.body: We listen to how the work happens today and where it slows you down.

steps.title: Define the solution
steps.body: We propose what to build, what to leave out and how it fits your tools.

steps.title: Agree on scope
steps.body: Deliverables, timeline and responsibilities are written down before work starts.

steps.title: Implement
steps.body: We build and configure the solution in small steps you can see along the way.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: You test it with real work. We adjust until it behaves the way you expect.

steps.title: Support
steps.body: After launch we stay available for questions, fixes and the next improvement.

custom.title: Custom AI Solutions
custom.body: Your process does not fit a standard package? We design workflows around your data, your tools and your team, from a single automation to a full internal system.
